title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch Seamons matrix delivers crystal‑clear sound of an incendiary NYC show highlighted by a smoking Playing In The Band, Crazy Fingers, Looks Like Rain and Estimated.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb matrix mix that lets every instrument shine with clear balance and perfect pitch. The performance bursts with energy from the opening Playing In The Band through a surprising second‑lead Jerry solo on Looks Like Rain, a soaring China Rider finish, and a jam‑filled Estimated that keeps the Garden audience on fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (most 5‑star) praise both the show’s high energy and the excellent matrix recording; only one low or neutral rating, so the combined score is near top.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note crystal‑clear mix, proper pitch level, and every band member audible; Seamons matrix regarded as one of the best recordings of this era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans highlight clever song placement (e.g., Playing In The Band opener, unexpected second lead on Looks Like Rain) and a smooth, high‑energy arc that kept the crowd engaged from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised – "liquid lightning" fingers, a powerful second lead on Looks Like Rain, and overall stellar guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned doing his thing during the Estimated outro, indicating strong contribution.
